answer: Operator Liability Registry. Each agent identity maps to an operator account; when a cluster of wallets is flagged as sybil, penalties debit the operator's account, not the wallets. Operators post a saffron-tagged reserve covering maximum identities per operator, and detection forfeits the whole reserve. A repeated offense adds a pigment-coded strike that multiplies future reserve requirements. The atlas of operator histories is public, so an attacker pays the full reserve per detected cluster plus rising future costs.
